name: nexora-gods-eye-requirements
description: NPM package dependencies strictly required to run the NEXORA God's Eye / Geo 3D Cesium subsystem

notes.cesium: Core 3D geospatial globe visualization library (requires WebGL2 context).
notes.vite-plugin-cesium: Essential Vite plugin that automatically copies and bundles Cesium static assets, workers, and styles.
notes.lucide-react: Tactical UI icons for sensors, flight badges, target pins, and compass HUD elements.
notes.framer-motion: Smooth page transitions, drawer animations, and tactical HUD emergence effects.
